name: Lakeside
title: Lakeside Window Cleaning, Rough Hollow Lakeway | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for the Lakeside section of Rough Hollow. Homes near Lake Travis, exterior windows $10 each, $200 minimum job. Text CleanzATX for a quote.
h1_em: near the lake, without the spots.
intro: Lakeside is a section of Rough Hollow close to the water, with homes priced from about $1M. CleanzATX cleans the windows here with pure water, with no soap film and no ladders against the house.

paragraphs: Lakeside is a smaller Rough Hollow section named for its closeness to the lake. Prices run from $1M up, which puts it below the waterfront pockets. Rough Hollow's stucco and stone look carries through, and the section is not gated.

You will find a mix of ages. Rough Hollow has been built in phases for years, so some Lakeside homes are a few years old and others are brand new. That affects glass, because newer builds often still have a film of builder residue on the panes.

The big pattern is lake breeze. It brings fine mist and a bit of dust across the roofs, and it settles on glass facing the water. In spring, live oak pollen coats everything in March and April. Screens trap it and tracks fill with a green yellow paste after the first rain.

Newer homes can have stickers, paint specks and stucco splatter on the glass. We scrape those carefully and finish with pure water. Hard water spot removal is $10 per pane when we find mineral buildup.

Lakeside is an easy stop. It is not gated, parking is simple and Rough Hollow HOA rules are the only ones in play. We often combine it with neighboring Waters Edge or Cypress Ridge visits, which keeps the route short.

A typical Lakeside home near 3,200 sq ft comes to about $320 for exterior windows and takes around two and a half hours outside. Inside and out at $15 a window includes everything. Our minimum job is $200, and quotes by text usually come back within the hour.

faq.q: Do you clean new construction glass?
faq.a: Yes, after the builder is done. We remove stickers and paint specks with care and finish with pure water so there is no film. Tell us about any special coatings.
Our lead time is usually within two weeks. We do not promise a specific date or a same day visit, but we will give you a realistic window by text.

faq.q: Is Lakeside close enough to get lake mist on the glass?
faq.a: Yes, when the wind comes off Lake Travis. The effect is lighter than on the shoreline, so twice a year is often enough here.

faq.q: What plan fits a Lakeside home?
faq.a: Twice a Year saves 10%, and most homes here do fine on that. If you have heavy tree cover or dirty screens, Triannual saves 15% and includes extras.

faq.q: Can you do the inside as well?
faq.a: Yes. Doing the interior along with the exterior runs $15 a window. Inside glass is hand squeegeed over drop cloths, with cotton covered ladders for two story rooms.

faq.q: Do you offer a touch up if it rains?
faq.a: Yes. Every job has a 7 day touch up. Text a photo and we come back free when we are in the area. Plan members on Triannual and up also get the 7 day rain guarantee.
